facts.business: Capacit'e Infraprojects Limited is an Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) company specializing in high-rise and super high-rise construction across residential, commercial, public, and institutional segments.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified Opinion on standalone financial statements; Key Audit Matter: Revenue recognition for long term construction contracts involving significant judgments in estimation of total revenue and cost to complete.

key_risks: Revenue recognition estimates for long-term construction contracts are inherently subjective and complex
Changes in judgements and estimates due to delay in timelines, changes in scope, and consequential revised contract prices
Accuracy of revenues, onerous obligations and profits may deviate significantly during project execution
